semantics: Undirected original graph and raw_integer/10 weights; weakly ordered visits; repeated vertex and source/target may satisfy consecutive requirements. Original categories fixed, no HSM inference.
outputs: Minimum distance plus ordered service vertices including endpoints. Equal-cost distinct service sequences are valid. Full road-walk reconstruction is not claimed or timed.
timing: Inside isolated child: candidate lookup/copy, query-specific initialization, bounds/search, query-cache construction and service-vertex reconstruction, ending when the adapter returns. Cleanup of state retained in global/cache containers is outside this timer for every method, as is fork/IPC, graph/index setup, correctness verification and serialization. Same fresh query-state policy for every method.
timeout_rule: External per-query deadline. A timeout has planner_ms=null and censor_ms=30000. If a completed child reports >30000ms, retain it as an observed-after-budget censored run; never use 30000 as actual runtime.

ROSE.storage: dense landmark vectors for POIs, source/target vectors computed online when needed

indices.DROMC_existing: Original H2H candidate-A*; initial reset of query-dependent heuristic/destination tables and normalization of service-vertex output inside timer; query algorithm retained.
indices.LayeredDijkstra: Original graph, initial labels from prior DP; stop after all next-layer targets settle; final target wave; compact per-candidate predecessor storage.

statistics: Nearest-rank median/P95 over per-query median of 3 repetitions, preserving right censoring. Also publish each repetition separately and timeout runs/(3*n), any-timeout query count and censored-median count. Do not treat repeats as independent queries.
counter_reporting: H2H calls for index methods; settled vertices/scanned edges for LayeredDijkstra. ROSE additionally reports candidate pair evaluations and refinements. Missing partial counts on timeout remain unknown; counters are not interchangeable work units.
